decisions.reason: The California PE license jurisdiction constrains the electrical endorser, not the required electrical load calculations, which are already represented by the candidate's message 20 INTRODUCE Event.
Requesting a California electrical PE license number does not change the existing deliverable of permit-ready electrical drawings.
The electrical PE license jurisdiction does not alter the HVAC sizing or Title 24 calculation requirements, which are already represented by the candidate's message 20 INTRODUCE Event.
The California electrical PE credential requirement applies to electrical endorsement and does not change the mechanical drawing deliverable.
